# Thunderbird Calendar browser and unit-test maintenance

Mock an invalid active title without replacing the draft with `draftState.setSectionValidity({ sessionKey: dialog.calendarEventSessionKey, section: "title", validity: { valid: false } })`; restore `{ valid: true }` to test re-enabling Save. `resetToCreateMode()` starts a fresh create draft and clears validation, so use it between independent cases, not to test correction of the same draft. [Task 1]

Scope: calendar.
